title: Run versioned checks against immutable snapshots and record attributable check runs
goal: Give AcceptanceAuthority executable check runs tied to the check version, target snapshot and actual environment, independent of any producer result.
scope: Implement register_check and run for visible/user checks with CheckAuthor, Independence, needs and version; support Command(program,args,inputs) and ExactBytes(path,digest). Record Baseline/Candidate/Control CheckRun roles, output/environment digests and Pass/Fail/Error(ErrorClass).

Build ProcessRunner with explicit Command executable/arguments/inputs and ExactBytes execution, bounded process lifecycle, verifier/input protection, retained stdout/stderr and environment identity. Run against the requested immutable Snapshot from W1-0005 rather than the changing live workspace. The adapter returns observations; AcceptanceAuthority validates and commits CheckRegistered/CheckRunRecorded.

Bind every CheckRun to the exact check version, target snapshot and environment so that W1-0019 can derive attributed Evidence later. This task creates no Evidence or Review records and needs no submitted ResultVersion; snapshots of a real temporary workspace are sufficient.
acceptance: Through AcceptanceAuthority, a real command and an exact-byte check run on two snapshots of a temporary workspace, retaining reproducible output and environment references. A deliberately incorrect artifact yields Fail while a missing executable or broken environment yields Error.
Changing the live workspace after a snapshot cannot change the checked snapshot; a CheckRun cannot be recorded against an unknown check version, snapshot or environment.

ProcessRunner and a materially different CheckRunner implementation are exercised through the same consumer; an adapter-returned outcome cannot register Trusted independence or mark a run as passing without kernel validation.

Create proposed crates/ymp-domain/src/verification.rs (Check, CheckSpec, CheckRun), the register_check/run part of crates/ymp-kernel/src/acceptance.rs and crates/ymp-runtime/src/checks/process.rs. W1-0005/0016 supply exact snapshot content; W1-0006 supplies assignment references for CheckAuthor. Evidence, Review and result applicability are W1-0019.

Command is the model’s explicit program/args/inputs contract. Do not substitute an unversioned shell string or a loose invocation-success label. W2 owns independent hidden design, Property/BrowserScenario/ExternalQuery, ContainerRunner and mutation.
